name: raudonas-knees
pose: HIGH KNEES, running in place: the right knee lifted high to hip height with the thigh parallel to the ground, the left foot planted on the ground, arms pumping like a sprinter (elbows bent 90 degrees, one forward, one back), slight forward lean, energetic determined grin. Front three-quarter view so the lifted knee is clearly visible.

name: melynas-squatjump
pose: SQUAT JUMP caught mid-air: jumping straight up explosively from a squat, both feet clearly off the ground with knees slightly tucked, both arms thrown straight up overhead in a V, joyful open-mouth expression, the hair puff bouncing. Front three-quarter view.

name: raudonas-sidestep
pose: LATERAL SIDE STEP in a half squat: knees bent, hips low, stepping wide to the side so the feet are far apart, hands clasped together in front of the chest, focused grin, body facing the viewer (front view), slight motion lean toward the stepping side.

name: melynas-lunge
pose: REVERSE LUNGE: the right leg stepped far back with the back knee bent low just above the floor, the front (left) knee bent at a right angle with the front foot flat on the ground, torso upright, hands on hips, focused confident smile. Three-quarter side view so both legs are clearly visible.

name: raudonas-crunch
pose: STANDING CROSS-BODY CRUNCH: balancing on the left leg, the right knee lifted high toward the chest, torso twisting so the LEFT elbow comes down across the body to touch the lifted right knee, the right hand behind the head, playful effort expression. Front three-quarter view.

name: raudonas-ready

name: raudonas-win

name: medaliai
pose: Subject: a set of EIGHT collectible 3D game achievement medals in exactly the same style, arranged in a tidy grid of 4 columns and 2 rows with generous even spacing, each medal the same size and facing the viewer straight on. Every medal: a chunky round coin-like badge with a thick rounded bright-yellow (#FFC61A) rim, a glossy coloured enamel face and ONE simple raised white symbol in the middle. Top row left to right: 1) mint green (#12B886) face with a play triangle; 2) royal blue (#2F6BFF) face with two crossed swords; 3) bright yellow (#FFC61A) face with a red flame; 4) red (#FF3B3B) face with a dumbbell. Bottom row left to right: 5) pink (#FF4F93) face with a lightning bolt; 6) violet (#7050F5) face with a trophy cup; 7) sky blue (#1FB0EA) face with a five-pointed star; 8) yellow (#FFC61A) face with three sparkles. Each medal is a die-cut sticker with a thick clean pure-white outline. Background: perfectly flat pure chroma green #00FF00, no gradient, no shadows on the background, nothing else. No text, no letters, no numbers.
